'''Hiroshi Tsuchida''' (Japanese: '''土田大''' ''Tsuchida Hiroshi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Tsuchida was born on February 8, 1954, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided the voice of {{an|Professor Sycamore}} during {{aniseries|XY}}. He then voiced [[Eusine]] in [[Pokémon Generations]]. In addition to voice acting roles, Tezuka is a live-action actor and has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|81 Produce}}.
